target_customer: Enterprise security and IT teams that need to govern employee use of generative AI tools and coding agents
problem: Employees paste sensitive data into AI tools and adopt unsanctioned AI apps, while security teams lack visibility, policy control and cost tracking.
business_model: B2B SaaS, enterprise AI gateway and governance; later positioned as governance for coding agents, free for teams of 50 or more developers per the current site
product_category: AI security and governance (AI gateway, data leakage prevention)

founders.name: Rajaram Srinivasan
founders.background_notes: Led data security products at Palo Alto Networks and Imperva per funding coverage.

founders.name: Vignesh Subbiah
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A gateway that redacts sensitive data in real time and routes high-risk prompts to hosted open-source models is standard security engineering with some hard parts (low latency, accurate detection).

defensibility.rationale: Integration into enterprise AI tools and policy configuration create some switching cost, but gateway and DLP features are copyable by security incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found describing incumbent actions against Unbound specifically; unverified that incumbents added gen AI DLP.

market_need_then: In 2024 enterprises were rapidly adopting gen AI tools and raising data leakage and shadow IT concerns; the seed coverage cites company claims of 7,000 prevented leaks.

branding.domain_note: Uses getunbound.ai and unboundsecurity.ai; the site footer names Web Sentry, Inc. as the legal entity. No source on how domains were acquired.

identity.logo: Simple wordmark with logo, per site
identity.voice_and_tone: Enterprise security, practical: 'AI governance that lets you go faster'

brand_strength.rationale: No evidence of brand press or community; the name collides with an older, unrelated Unbound Security (key management) and the open-source Unbound DNS server.

outcome_analysis: Unbound is active and raised a 4 million dollar seed round in May 2025 led by Race Capital, about a year after its Summer 2024 YC batch. Founders with data security product experience at Palo Alto Networks and Imperva suit the market, and enterprise anxiety about gen AI leakage is a tailwind. The positioning has moved toward governing coding agents, which shows adaptation. Whether it can stay ahead of large security vendors is not yet known.
notes: A Dealroom listing shows 'Acquired' for an Unbound Security, but that is likely the older unrelated Israeli key management company. A Seedtable listing mentions a separate 4.5M figure, unverified. No dated competitor sources near the 2024 batch were found, so the list is empty. Series A or later rounds searched for and none found.
